On Colibri VFxx and iMX6, PIN_55 and PIN_63 supports on-module CAN. CAN1_TX and
CAN1_RX are available on PIN_55 and PIN_63 respectively. This is a module specific feature
and may not be supported by all the computer-on-modules in the Colibri family. For more
details, refer to the datasheet of Colibri computer-on-modules.
The PWM_A signal is also routed to the RGB display connector (X7) to provide backlight
brightness control for the connected LCD displays; for this reason a populated zero ohm
resistor (R15) is placed before connector X9.
The Colibri PXA3XX does not support the PWM_D signal on pin 67; however, it is available on
pin 152 of the SODIMM connector. An option has been provided through a 0 (zero) ohm
resistor (R42), which is, by default, not part of the assembly. This resistor allows you to
connect SODIMM 152 to pin 42 of the Extension Connector.
